summary.headline: PNG Jewellers Q1 FY27 revenue rose 41% YoY to INR2,413 crore, with EBITDA up 57% to INR192.4 crore and PAT up 52% to INR105.3 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations grew 41% YoY to INR2,413 crore, driven by retail (up 56%, with 46% SSSG), franchise (up 8%) and e-commerce (up 20%). EBITDA margin expanded 80 bps to 8.0% and PAT margin rose 40 bps to 4.4%, with gross margin flat at 13.2% reported. Management kept FY27 guidance (around 25 store additions to 103 stores, about 7% EBITDA margin, about INR400 crore other expenses) and flagged that Q1 other expenses were low due to cuts in marketing and no store launches. Hedging gains and lower other income were discussed in detail, and the promoter stake and franchise economics drew scrutiny.

financial_highlights.change: Reported gross margin flat YoY; adjusted ex-hedging up ~40-50 bps per CFO
vs ~INR12 crore in Q4 FY26 (analyst cited INR31 crore, CFO disputed); lower FD balances on mortgage

segments.name: Retail
segments.commentary: Grew 56% with 46% SSSG; now about 78% of total revenue, with jewellery about 78-79% of retail and bars/coins about 20-21%. Newer North and Central India stores run 15-18% studded ratios.

segments.name: Franchise
segments.commentary: Grew 8% YoY; management attributed the slowdown to B2B billing timing and stock replenishment, with franchise openings expected to pick up in Q2-Q3 (about 10 legacy and 5 litestyle planned).

segments.name: E-commerce
segments.commentary: Grew 20% YoY; company is deliberately shifting mix towards jewellery and away from bars/coins, so management expects better margins but slower total sales growth.

segments.name: Litestyle by PNG
segments.commentary: Studded ratio 32.9% in Q1; current litestyle gross margin of about 18-20%, with management targeting about 50% studded ratio in two years and 30-35% margin later.

guidance_outlook: Open around 25 stores in FY27, taking network to about 103 by March 2027 (63 COCO, balance FOCO); a few launches in Q2, bulk in Q3-Q4.
Network targets: about 140 stores by March 2028 and about 177 by March 2029 (about 113 legacy and 64 litestyle; about 75 COCO and 40 FOCO by March 2029).
EBITDA margin guidance of about 7% for full year FY27; other expenses about 3% of sales or roughly INR400 crore for FY27.
PAT margin underlying (ex-hedging gains) targeted at 4.1-4.25% in FY27 per CFO, versus 4.2% per CEO; 4.5-4.7% by FY29.
Hedging coverage to reach about 80% around Q3 FY27 (Q2 around 80% per CEO), and fully hedged in FY28; currently 70%+.
Gold metal loan of INR1,500-1,550 crore to be reduced by INR500-600 crore by FY29, non-GML borrowing about INR1,200 crore; targeted debt-free in four to five years.
Gross margin guidance for retail mix of 13-14% (CFO: 12.5-13.5% at 10-11% studded ratio), including hedging gains shown separately.
capex_capacity: Store count 78 at end-Q1 FY27 (57 COCO, 21 FOCO).
FY27 plan: 25 new stores, bulk in Q3 and Q4, franchise-led; deepening Maharashtra and expanding UP, Bihar, Central India and NCR.
UP stores running 18%+ studded versus 15% projection; 8-10 UP franchise openings planned in FY27; Ayodhya store opening soon.
Capital allocation focused on store expansion, franchise network, digital and operational excellence, funded from internal accruals.
Management plans a QIP at a suitable time to reduce promoter holding (above 75%); board enabling resolution already in place.
demand_pricing: Management said demand held up through April-June despite record gold prices, supported by weddings and Akshaya Tritiya; Adhik Maas was muted due to high silver prices.
Weddings postponed by Adhik Maas expected to benefit Q2 and a large part of Q3.
Customers shifting towards lightweight jewellery, studded products and old gold exchange, favouring organised players.
Hedging gains: Q3 FY26 about INR45 crore, Q4 FY26 about INR20 crore, Q2 FY26 about INR5.5-6 crore; gains shrinking as hedging coverage rises.
Marketing kept within 1.5% of sales; 250-300 hoardings cut versus last year. FY26 other expenses included about INR40-50 crore for UP launch and one-time campaigns that are not expected to recur.
Inventory turns stabilised at about 3.5-4x after refinery and B2B sales wound down (previously about 7x).

qa_highlights.question: Why is gross margin flat YoY despite mix shift toward retail, and what is the ideal retail margin at a 10-11% studded ratio?
qa_highlights.answer: Reported gross margin is flat because hedging gains are shown separately; ex-hedging adjusted gross margin is up about 40-50 bps YoY. Management targets 12.5-13.5% retail margin at a 10-11% studded ratio, and 13-14% overall retail gross margin including hedging gains.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses grow only about 5% despite store expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited conservative spending amid demand uncertainty, lower scheme-redemption discounts, marketing kept within 1.5% of sales with 250-300 hoardings cut, and no store launches in Q1. Spending will rise in Q3-Q4 with expansion, but EBITDA guidance is still expected to be met.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 other expense guidance and why was other income so different between Q4 and Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Other expenses are guided at about 3% of sales, roughly INR400 crore for FY27. Other income was about INR10 crore in Q1 versus about INR12 crore in Q4 per the CFO, who said lower fixed deposits placed on mortgage drove the decline; cash and hedging margin money also hold some balances.

qa_highlights.question: What is the store expansion and COCO/FOCO mix plan through FY29?
qa_highlights.answer: Plan adds 25 stores in FY27 to reach 103 (63 COCO, balance FOCO), then 37 each in FY28 and FY29 to reach 140 and 177. By March 2029, about 75 COCO and 40 FOCO, with 113 legacy and 64 litestyle stores.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin trajectory and hedging plan?
qa_highlights.answer: PAT margin underlying ex-hedging is targeted at 4.1-4.25% in FY27 per the CFO, versus about 4.2% per the CEO; 4.5-4.7% by FY29. Hedging is about 70%+ now, targeted at about 80% around Q3 FY27 and fully hedged in FY28. Hedging gains were about INR45 crore in Q3 FY26, INR20 crore in Q4 FY26 and INR5.5-6 crore in Q2 FY26.

qa_highlights.question: How is Litestyle progressing on studded mix, gross margin and store count?
qa_highlights.answer: Studded ratio is about 32.9-34% now, targeted at about 50% in a couple of years. Current litestyle gross margin is about 18-20%, versus 30-35% for the format once studded mix rises. Litestyle store target is 65-70 by March 2029 and about 100 over the longer term.

qa_highlights.question: Why are franchise revenue growth (8%) and e-commerce growth lower than company-operated stores?
qa_highlights.answer: Franchise sales are booked as B2B, so initial stocking and replenishment timing affect quarterly numbers; management expects franchise openings to pick up in Q2-Q3 (about 10 legacy and 5 litestyle). E-commerce is deliberately shifting mix away from bars and coins toward jewellery, so margins should improve but total sales growth may slow.

risks_watch: Reported gross margin flat YoY; expansion of hedging gains is shrinking as hedging coverage rises toward 80% by Q3 FY27 and full coverage in FY28, so reported margin depends on underlying retail mix.
Other expenses are guided to rise in Q3-Q4 with store openings; Q1 spend (about 5% growth) was unusually low, so H2 cost run-rate against about INR400 crore guidance needs monitoring.
Franchise revenue growth of 8% versus company-operated retail growth of 56%; visibility into franchise B2C sell-through is still being built and management has only recently gained system access.
Promoter holding above 75% with a QIP planned at a suitable time; timing and size are not specified and the stock overhang remains.
Gold metal loan of INR1,500-1,550 crore to fall by INR500-600 crore by FY29; execution of the debt-reduction path and the litestyle studded-mix shift (from about 34% toward 50%) are key checkpoints.

Other income fell to about INR10 crore from about INR12 crore in Q4 per the CFO, after the analyst cited INR31 crore; the figure was disputed on the call and should be reconciled against the filed numbers.
key_quotes: Their confidence has enabled us to deliver our highest ever first quarter, beginning FY27 on a strong note.
Despite elevated gold prices, our performa nce remains in line with our previously communicated guidance.
So franchise apple-to-apple on a quarter-to-quarter, these differences which will come, but having said that, we understand because franchise is our focus now, will be becoming big.
Eventually, we plan to take it to 80% studded inventory at a store le vel and 20% gold inventory and that would also enable us to reach a 50% to 60% studded ratio in that category.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, store expansion and the long-term plan, with precise targets given across FY27-FY29. Cautious and somewhat evasive on the reasons for flat gross margin and the other income gap, leaning on adjusted (ex-hedging) figures and deferring some answers to later quarters.

growth.why: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 41% YoY to INR2,413 cr with 46% SSSG, and management held ~25 store additions (78 to ~103) with bulk in Q3-Q4, but no explicit revenue growth guidance was given and the franchise and e-commerce segments slowed.
